name: hptsmart-mobile-1-1-2
description: HPTSmart Android/iOS Capacitor wrapper based on HPTSmart 1.1.2

scripts.cap:sync:android: npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.cjs
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npx cap sync ios && node scripts/patch-ios.cjs
scripts.build:android:debug: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.build:ios: npm run cap:sync:ios && npx cap open ios
